title: S&P 500 Correction: Five Forces Behind the Market Sell-Off
summary: The S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average closed in correction territory (down more than 10% from their October highs) on Friday Nov 20. The Nasdaq Composite plunged 5.28% to 22,617.73, erasing all 2026 gains, in its largest one-week pullback since 2020. CNBC identifies five forces: AI capex doubts, Nvidia CEO crisis, Anthropic IPO overhang, Fed rate-hike re-pricing, and rising dollar pressure.
why: 美股全面进入回调区，AI赛道科技股首当其冲，VIX升至30创近8个月新高；持有英伟达、Intel等科技股及相关sell put期权的投资者需评估下行风险与保证金充足性。

title: Fed's Waller: Central Bank May Need to 'Shock People' With Half-Point Rate Hike
summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said the Fed may need to surprise markets with an aggressive 50-basis-point rate increase at the December 8-9 meeting if inflation data remain sticky. He said if core CPI reads close to 0.3%, a 50bp hike should be on the table. CME FedWatch data show roughly 97% probability for at least a 25bp hike in December.
why: 沃勒放鹰震惊市场50bp信号令隐含波动率抬升；12月加息路径更激进的预期将进一步压制成长股估值，尤其对持有HK/US科技股sell put策略影响显著。

title: Warsh Wants Fed to Talk Less, But Rate-Hike Signals Keep Coming
summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has advocated for curbing forward guidance, but regional Fed officials (Waller, Bullard) have been making increasingly explicit rate-hike remarks ahead of the December meeting. Warsh himself has remained deliberately vague on the rate path, while emphasizing the Fed will achieve price stability.
why: 美联储主席沃什主动收窄前瞻指引但难阻鹰派声音，市场不确定性上升；12月会议前波动率预计维持高位，对期权卖出策略（sell put）构成持续压力。

title: Intel Signs First External Customer for Advanced 18A Chipmaking Process
summary: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan announced at the TomorrowX Summit in Austin that Intel has signed its first outside customer for the 18A process node. The client identity was not disclosed; CTO Pushkar Ranade later said it signed for 18A-P, the improved variant in risk production since June. Intel also named Microsoft as its first publicly announced EMIB advanced packaging customer.
why: Intel 18A外部客户突破是代工转型里程碑，有助修复市场对INTC晶圆代工前景的信心；Intel在此次美股大盘回调中因此消息一度逆市上涨，值得持续关注。

title: 腾讯前三季度资本开支超千亿元 高管：2028年财务趋势将改善
summary: 腾讯三季度财报电话会披露，前三季度资本开支（含宽带采购）超1000亿元，同比大幅提升；高管表示AI基础设施部署将带动2028年经营利润率显著改善。WorkBuddy日活超千万，云服务收入同比增35%。公司承认元宝未达预期，已大幅削减相关投入。
why: 管理层明确给出2028年利润率回升的前瞻指引，对腾讯长线持有者是重要锚点；短期大额资本开支仍压制Non-IFRS利润（三季度同比-6%），关注期权市场对此指引的消化情况。
